away.name: Devon Levi
away.news: Levi has been far from spectacular, but he has won both of his outings and will return to the crease for a third straight game on Wednesday against the Anaheim Ducks. The 24-year-old goalie has a chance to earn significant playing time in Edmonton, but he certainly hopes to improve his 4.02 GAA and .810 SV% over his two games this season (2-0-0).

home.name: Lukas Dostal
home.news: With Ville Husso as his backup, the Ducks will likely rely heavily on Dostal, who returns to the crease Wednesday against the Edmonton Oilers. The 26-year-old Dostal has played both games for the Ducks this season (2-0-0), posting a solid 2.42 GAA and .918 SV%. It will be his first time facing the Oilers since helping eliminate them from last postseason in six games. The Ducks enter Wednesday's contest as +116 home underdogs against the Oilers, who have scored 17 goals in their first three games (2-0-1).
